programmes.d: An amateur photographer is exploring a beautiful cove in British Columbia when he falls 20ft from a cliff.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Dr. Bikini
programmes.d: A resort doctor must treat a man critically injured by a boat propeller; a discharged patient sets off a deadly chain of events by getting a ride from his designated driver; the ER comes to a standstill when the computers and the head nurse are down.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: A Life In Their Hands
programmes.d: A young girl comes into the ER and can't move from the waist down. Her parents are angry as the doctors sent her home a week earlier.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Shredded!
programmes.d: A man is rushed to the ER, apparently clawed by a tiger, but he won't reveal the real source of his injuries; a patient says he's been shot in the head, but the bullet is nowhere to be found; a woman is brain dead, but one doctor thinks she can be saved.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Stuck In A Toilet
programmes.d: A woman is stuck for over 18 hours in a toilet bowl; doctors struggle to save the life of a man who's been mangled by a stump grinder; when a nurse collapses in the hospital, doctors and staff make a shocking discovery.
When a young couple is discovered murdered, It will take almost 40 years to uncover the killer of childhood sweethearts.
After the meticulously planned murder of his family, a businessman successfully evades authorities for 18 years.
The story of the Baton Rouge Serial Killer, known for murdering seven women in the area and sentenced to death for his chilling crimes.

programmes.t: World's Most Evil Killers: Harry Jarvis
programmes.d: When Carol Jarvis disappeared, her husband told friends and family that she'd simply gone on a little holiday.

In August 2002, a young man and woman, once dating, headed for the Amazon rain forest but got lost in the jungle. They have to survive the dangers of the jungle and hold on to their sanity as they find their way home.
When a Hollywood camera crew set out to film an active volcano they end up in a helicopter crash into the active volcano. All rescue attempts are delayed by lava, toxic gases and bad weather.
5 young guys from Bozeman, Montana have got together for a back-country ski trip to celebrate New Year 2005.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: I Hate Doctors
programmes.d: A hospital worker feels like she's dying, but doctors can find nothing wrong; a physician's young son is a patient in her own ER, demanding her attention while she's trying to treat others; a woman's hobby of wild mushroom picking sends her to the ER.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Plastered
programmes.d: A college student is dropped off at the ER with her face covered in a plaster mask; doctors are baffled when a stroke patient's heart keeps stopping and restarting without intervention; two teens arrive separately with bizarre symptoms that are similar.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: My Job Is Mayhem
programmes.d: A man injured in a medieval roleplaying battle has a sword impaled in his head; a critically ill patient is so afraid of germs he won't allow doctors to treat him; two patients with the same life-threatening symptoms arrive separately from a fashion show.
A damaged man turns Cleveland, Ohio, into a hunting ground as part of a twisted plot to exact revenge on the women who hurt him.
A woman's dream leads cops in coastal Florida to the body of a dead woman hidden in the bushes on a beach.
When a series of women are murdered in Baton Rouge, police draw a profile and begin DNA testing a segment of the city’s population.
